description: Large pothole outside school gate; bikes nearly crash every morning.
Garbage dumped beside apartment for four days and children pass here daily.
Water pipe burst and water is flooding the main road.
Open drain overflowing into houses after rainfall.
Streetlight not working and road is completely dark at night.
Road accident with injured people; ambulance required immediately.
Large tree fallen across road and traffic is blocked.
Smoke and flames coming from commercial building.
Sewage manhole overflowing near market and creating slippery road.
Pothole on highway lane causing sudden braking.
